findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Defs.lean:197-207 — `RingHom.toAlgebra`/`RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra` are stated for `(i : R →+* S)` with no base ring. The file's own Implementation notes justify `CommSemiring B` but never the `AlgHom` restriction. In-repo evidence that the gap is at the `RingHom` level: TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AbelianVariety/Basic.lean:211-214 does the same pointwise unfolding for a `RingEquiv`-derived ring hom, which the `AlgHom`-only lemma cannot serve.
findings.fix: State `RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply {A B} [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] (i : A →+* B) (z : A) : @algebraMap A B _ _ i.toAlgebra z = i z` as the primary lemma; if the `f z` right-hand side is wanted, derive the `AlgHom` form from it in one line (`(f.toRingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply z).trans (AlgHom.coe_toRingHom f ▸ rfl)`).
findings.issue: `AlgHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply` is about `RingHom.toAlgebra`, but is stated only for an `AlgHom`: `R`, `[CommSemiring R]`, `[Algebra R A]`, `[Algebra R B]` play no role in the statement's content or its proof (which rewrites by `RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra` and then strips the `AlgHom` coercion). A caller holding a bare ring hom — the ordinary way `toAlgebra` is used — cannot apply it.

findings.evidence: Degree.lean:151-155 `finiteDimensional_functionField (φ) [Algebra W₂.FunctionField W₁.FunctionField] (h : ∀ z, algebraMap … = φ.fieldPullback z) : FiniteDimensional W₂.FunctionField W₁.FunctionField`, proved independently via `FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos`; Separability.lean:249 and :275 call `TauCeti.AlgHom.finiteDimensional_of_fieldRange φ.fieldPullback hφ` / `ψ.fieldPullback hψ` under exactly those hypotheses; Degree.lean:112 supplies the `fieldRange` finiteness instance.
findings.fix: Keep the general lemma and reduce the special case to it: `Isogeny.finiteDimensional_functionField φ h := AlgHom.finiteDimensional_of_fieldRange φ.fieldPullback h` in Degree.lean (already touched by this PR), so the fact has a single proof.
findings.issue: `AlgHom.finiteDimensional_of_fieldRange` instantiated at `f = φ.fieldPullback` is verbatim the pre-existing `Isogeny.finiteDimensional_functionField` (same hypothesis `h`, same conclusion; the `[FiniteDimensional f.fieldRange L]` instance is `Isogeny.finiteDimensional`). The repo now carries two public proofs of one fact, and the PR's two call sites use the new one although the existing one is in scope.

summary: The isogeny-level definitions and theorems sit at the natural level, and my prior findings on the buried helper and the dead finiteness hypotheses are resolved. The two supporting additions are not: the new `AlgHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply` is stated a level below the fact it proves, and `AlgHom.finiteDimensional_of_fieldRange` restates an existing in-repo lemma with a second independent proof.
